topline.text: Another quiet 24-48 hours - a thorough sweep of DfE, Ofsted, SEND/AP, behaviour, safeguarding, funding and Sheffield/South Yorkshire sources found nothing genuinely new since yesterday's briefing.
Keeping this short rather than padding it out with older stories you've likely already seen - normal-length service resumes as soon as something new breaks.

diary.text: ONS publishes its next NEET (not in education, employment or training) statistics for the UK, 9:30am - relevant to post-16 pathways and AP/SEND transitions work.

box.text: schools say literacy is a key challenge for their disadvantaged pupils, with 8 in 10 citing attendance too - the two issues inclusion leads are most often firefighting together.
